_employee: E007, Data Engineer. Gaps: Snowflake 3 to 4, Apache Spark 2 to 3. SQL at 5, above role. SnowPro Core expires 2026-10-01 with 18 of 30 renewal credits. Weekly limit 5 hours. Previously rejected: Saturday study blocks, Talend certification track. Previously accepted: pairing sessions with the platform team on Snowflake performance.
_instructions: For each pair, both candidates already pass the hard checks (every gap addressed, verified resources only, hours within limit). Pick the one you would rather receive. Set igor_preferred to 'A' or 'B'.

pairs.A: Weeks 1 to 4: Snowflake certification preparation path, 4 hours a week, aimed at earning the 12 missing renewal credits before the October expiry. Weeks 5 to 10: Apache Spark course, 4 hours a week, with the platform team pairing sessions continuing on Snowflake performance. Week 11: Spark hands-on lab, 5 hours.
pairs.B: Weeks 1 to 6: Apache Spark course and lab, 5 hours a week, because Spark is the larger gap and the next project needs it. Weeks 7 to 10: Snowflake certification preparation, 4 hours a week, then renew.
pairs.note: B defers the renewal past the expiry date. A sequences the hard deadline first and keeps the accepted pairing sessions.

pairs.A: Alternate weeks between Snowflake and Spark for twelve weeks, 5 hours each week, so neither skill goes cold. Use the certification prep path for Snowflake and the course plus lab for Spark.
pairs.B: Weeks 1 to 4 on Snowflake certification prep at 4 hours, then weeks 5 to 12 on Spark at 5 hours, course first, then lab. Renewal credits are complete by week 4, ahead of the expiry.
pairs.note: Alternating weeks sounds balanced but spreads the renewal across the deadline. B is duller and safer.

pairs.A: Snowflake prep path in weeks 1 to 4 at 4 hours, Spark course in weeks 5 to 9 at 5 hours, Spark lab in week 10. Saturday morning blocks for the lab work.
pairs.B: Snowflake prep path in weeks 1 to 4 at 4 hours, Spark course in weeks 5 to 9 at 5 hours, Spark lab in week 10. Weekday evening blocks, two sessions a week.
pairs.note: Identical except A schedules Saturdays, which the employee rejected last time. Memory must count.

pairs.A: Close the Snowflake gap through the certification prep path (weeks 1 to 4, 4 hours) and the Spark gap through the course (weeks 5 to 9, 4 hours) and lab (week 10, 4 hours). Renewal credits logged by week 4. Pairing sessions continue throughout.
pairs.B: Improve on Snowflake and Spark over the next quarter using recommended learning resources at a sustainable pace within the weekly limit, renewing the certification before it lapses.
pairs.note: B is grounded, in policy, and says nothing. This is the residual-risk case: a plan that passes every check and is still not advice.
